sources.title: Turn graphs and extremal surfaces in free groups
sources.used_parts: Section4 turn graph duality; Lemma3; Lemma5; Proposition6. Equation(3) supplies scl=|w|/4−diskcount/(2n).
sources.source_text_caution: The final proof displays a plus sign in A(u), inconsistent with equations(2)–(3). This calculation uses only the directly derived Euler characteristic objective and Lemma3, not that final formula.

third_party_software: None vendored. Optional solver execution used existing isolated SymPy1.14.0; certificate verification uses only Python standard library.
